description.value:
Rank 3 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 25 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: 30 feet
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

You fire a flurry of blasts from your weapon, basing it out of the type of weapon that you wield. Make a number of Combo Attack Rolls equal to half of your Proficiency Bonus, each dealing your Weapon Damage Die on a hit. Each attack may target a different target or each can indiviually be sent at the same.

system.requirements: 1 *Simple or Martial Weapon* that you are proficient with.
